Italian-style modular link bracelets take center stage in this collection of stainless steel jewelry featuring decorative gold accents and interchangeable charms. The assortment includes two silver-tone expandable link bracelets adorned with gold symbols, hearts, and other decorative motifs, along with an additional convertible bracelet by Ornamates. The Ornamates bracelet retains its original packaging and includes three colorful Linkmates charms.
A separately packaged Italian link charm completes the collection. The assortment features a combination of polished stainless steel, decorative links, and charms identified as having 14K and 18K gold accents, offering opportunities for personalized bracelet designs.
An appealing collection for enthusiasts of Italian charm bracelets and customizable jewelry.

282135767.description:
Maxell XLII 90
High Bias Type II Blank Audio Cassettes
Lot of 3 Sealed Tapes
The Maxell XLII is an iconic Type II high-bias cassette formulation renowned for its low noise, wide dynamic range, and consistent high-frequency response. Featuring the classic packaging with the legendary Steve Steigman "Blown Away" chair visual, these tapes were designed specifically to capture the clarity of digital audio and CD sources. Manufactured in Japan, Maxell XLII cassettes remain highly sought after by vintage audio enthusiasts and recording hobbyists.
High Bias IEC Type II formulation with 70s equalization
90 minutes total recording time (2 x 45 minutes) / 135 meters (443 feet)
Lot includes 3 individually factory-sealed blank audio cassette tapes in original cellophane
Made in Japan as indicated on rear packaging
Condition:
All three cassette tapes are brand new and factory sealed in original manufacturer shrink wrap. The clear plastic wrap is fully intact on each tape with no tears, holes, or unsealed seams. Jewel cases and internal j-cards appear pristine beneath the wrap.
